   294  /*=========================================================================
   295   * define macros for push and pop the status in to / out of the stack
   296   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   297
   298  /* There are a few little points in pushing into and popping from the status
   299     stack:
   300     1. when the embedding level is not valid (more than
   301     FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL=125), you must reject it, and not to push
   302     into the stack, but when you see a PDF, you must find the matching code,
   303     and if it was pushed in the stack, pop it, it means you must pop if and
   304     only if you have pushed the matching code, the over_pushed var counts the
   305     number of rejected codes so far.
   306
   307     2. there's a more confusing point too, when the embedding level is exactly
   308     FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL-1=124, an LRO, LRE, or LRI is rejected
   309     because the new level would be FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL+1=126, that
   310     is invalid; but an RLO, RLE, or RLI is accepted because the new level is
   311     FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL=125, that is valid, so the rejected codes
   312     may be not continuous in the logical order, in fact there are at most two
   313     continuous intervals of codes, with an RLO, RLE, or RLI between them.  To
   314     support this case, the first_interval var counts the number of rejected
   315     codes in the first interval, when it is 0, means that there is only one
   316     interval.
   317
   318  */
   319
   320  /* a. If this new level would be valid, then this embedding code is valid.
   321     Remember (push) the current embedding level and override status.
   322     Reset current level to this new level, and reset the override status to
   323     new_override.
   324     b. If the new level would not be valid, then this code is invalid. Don't
   325     change the current level or override status.
   326  */
   327  #define PUSH_STATUS \
   328      FRIBIDI_BEGIN_STMT \
   329        if LIKELY(over_pushed == 0 \
   330                  && isolate_overflow == 0 \
   331                  && new_level <= FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL)   \
   332          { \
   333            if UNLIKELY(level == FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL - 1) \
   334              first_interval = over_pushed; \
   335            status_stack[stack_size].level = level; \
   336            status_stack[stack_size].isolate_level = isolate_level; \
   337            status_stack[stack_size].isolate = isolate; \
   338            status_stack[stack_size].override = override; \
   339            stack_size++; \
   340            level = new_level; \
   341            override = new_override; \
   342          } else if LIKELY(isolate_overflow == 0) \
   343            over_pushed++; \
   344      FRIBIDI_END_STMT
   345
   346  /* If there was a valid matching code, restore (pop) the last remembered
   347     (pushed) embedding level and directional override.
   348  */
   349  #define POP_STATUS \
   350      FRIBIDI_BEGIN_STMT \
   351        if (stack_size) \
   352        { \
   353          if UNLIKELY(over_pushed > first_interval) \
   354            over_pushed--; \
   355          else \
   356            { \
   357              if LIKELY(over_pushed == first_interval) \
   358                first_interval = 0; \
   359              stack_size--; \
   360              level = status_stack[stack_size].level; \
   361              override = status_stack[stack_size].override; \
   362              isolate = status_stack[stack_size].isolate; \
   363              isolate_level = status_stack[stack_size].isolate_level; \
   364            } \
   365        } \
